draft.emotion: gentle and respectful, softening a request to be polite
notes: The ending changes according to who you are addressing: مِنْ فَضْلِكَ (min faḍlika) to a man, مِنْ فَضْلِكِ (min faḍliki) to a woman; in everyday speech both often become min faḍlak / min faḍlik.
